intent: Hewn pale ruin-stone pauldrons, chest and crown over bright green-bronze arms, greaves and belt, with a bronze crest swept up the helm, a gold brow band and a gold-ringed bronze sun on the chest; from the high camera it reads as pale stone blocks on green-bronze limbs under a gold band.
requests: A pale stone material that reads as carved rock at the high camera; Granite and Marble both go flat under the mood light.
A sun-gold that stays bright without a specular light, so the brow band and chest ring read as gold rather than brass at distance.
